decision_scope: SELECT_ONLY_THE_POST_POSITION_1_OPI_PIPELINE_STRATEGY; DO_NOT_ASSIGN_POSITION_2, AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_ANOTHER_OPI, REUSE_POSITION_1_SOURCE_PACKAGE, CREATE_CANONICAL_OPI_IDS_OR_LABELS, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

strategy_decisions.statement: Require fresh source/evidence review before assigning any content to internal position selector 2.
Do not reuse VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE for position 2 without separate evidence and approval.
Do not assign, author or validate position 2 in this strategy gate.
Create no canonical OPI IDs or labels.
If approved, open only a separate position-2 source-review gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Position-1 validation does not generalize its source package to the remaining nine OPI positions.
No subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or natural-language translation semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH and KE CANDIDATE/non-generalized remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this post-position-1 strategy while this gate remains active.
